title: [K-Poppin'] "Singlish" Day with DKB(다크비) :Capture all the beautiful things from 🎵 Get Away🚘
description:
Learn Korean and English on "Singlish" every Monday!
DKB joins us every week to learn a pop song the listeners chose! Penalties await too! Every Monday from 1-2pm kst don't forget to join in!

💛 Today’s Guests: TEO(테오), GK, 희찬 (HEECHAN) from DKB(다크비)
💛 Today’s Singlish:  Get Away -DKB ❤️ 🔥

📌Today's expression:  
아름다운 것들 전부 내 눈에 담아 
Capture all the beautiful things in my eyes
선물할게 너에게만 For You Lil’ Mama
I will gift them to you For You Lil’ Mama
저기 저 에메랄드빛 푸른 바다
Look at that emerald green sea 
말도 안 되는 View에 웃음만 나와
Unbelievable view makes me smile
